title: Citi Dialed Back Its US Stock Call After The AI Selloff - Finimize
text: Bookmarks Free Newsletter Free Newsletter Ideas Guides Events For Business Bookmarks Browse News News Research Research Markets Markets Citi Dialed Back Its US Stock Call After The AI Selloff Strategists cut US equities and global tech to neutral, warning Nasdaq positioning could flip net-short while they favored European stocks and health care. Finimize Newsroom 1 min What's going on here? Citigroup, a global investment bank, just cooled on US stocks and global tech after an AI-driven pullback, warning that positioning in the Nasdaq could slip into “net-short” territory. What does this mean? In a note on Monday, Citi strategists led by Beata Manthey cut US equities to “neutral” from “overweight” and made the same move on global technology, saying they want “cleaner positioning and more stable sentiment” after a sharp drop in big AI-linked names. Their focus is less about one company’s earnings and more about market plumbing. When a crowded trade unwinds, investors who use rules to control risk can end up selling simply because volatility has risen, no.. isen, not because the long-term story changed. Citi also argued that recent selling has broadened across regions and sectors, which can make rebounds harder to sustain. So it leaned toward areas it thinks are less tethered to the AI mood swings, upgrading European equities excluding the UK, plus Global Health Care and European Food & Beverage. Why should I care? For markets: Citi’s net-short Nasdaq warning is really about fast-moving flows. If Nasdaq futures positioning flips from net-long to net-short, the “marginal buyer” can shift from long-term investors to short-term flows. That can create a loop where rising volatility forces systematic strategies – like risk-targeting funds and trend followers, which mechanically cut exposure when markets get jumpier – to sell more. In that setup, rallies often come from short-covering rather than fresh demand, so they can fade quickly, while drawdowns can travel further before stabilizing. Citi’s move to neutral on US equities and tech, and its preference for Europe and health care, is a bet that parts of the market with less AI concentration may deliver a steadier ride while the tech trade resets.
